Note: Record.Rename does not rewrite the referencing field on rows whose TableRelation points at the renamed record; the child keeps the old key. The sibling assertions in this codeunit (ValidateTableRelation = false must NOT propagate, and the no-relation 'Soft Ref' control) already pass, so only the propagating case is declared here.

On a PAGE-driven Modify, xRec mirrors Rec instead of holding the before-image. The code-driven half of the same contract (codeunit 60179) passes and must keep passing — xRec mirroring Rec is correct there — so this is specifically the page-write path.
